title: MetaObjects Python codegen config
description: Declarative config for the `metaobjects` Python CLI (#267). Schema keys mirror the TS metaobjects.config.ts vocabulary (outDir/generators/entities/providers/metadata).

metadata.description: Metadata directory, relative to this config file. Default: metaobjects

providers.description: Consumer provider refs as 'module:symbol', resolved relative to this config file's directory (no PYTHONPATH needed).

libraries.description: MetaObjects-shipped library packages to load alongside `metadata` (e.g. ["ai"]). An unknown package name is refused.

requirementTests.description: Options of the `requirement-tests` generator (one pytest file per metamodel package, one test per declared requirement). Every key is optional.

witnessModule.description: Dotted module holding the project-owned witness functions: one per generated test, named by the test's witness key.

grain.description: What one test stands for. `concern`: one per distinct <type>.<subType> a requirement claims. `member`: one per distinct @implementedBy reference that resolves.

renderer.description: A 'module:symbol' renderer hook, resolved relative to this config file's directory. It is called with the test's RequirementTestArgs and returns a RenderedTest, or None to keep the default.

filter.description: A 'module:symbol' predicate over the requirement view that chooses which requirements get a test, replacing the default (functional, level 4 or above).

warnUncovered.description: Name the requirements the filter excluded, once, capped at five. It never fails the build.

targets.description: Named run-specs; each key is a target name.

outDir.description: Output directory, relative to this config file.

generators.description: Stable generator names (see `metaobjects gen --list`). Required: there is no default suite, so a target that names none generates nothing and `verify --codegen` checks nothing.

entities.description: Entity-name allowlist. Omit to emit every entity.
